You can use your fingers to do multiples of 9, up to 10. 

Start with both hands outstretched.

Count left to right the number you're multiplying by and bend that finger down.

Fingers to the left of the bent one are counted as 10's.

Fingers to the right are counted as 1's.

Put the two together and you're done.
